mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a backyard sauna in King Township?

acceptedAnswer.text: An accessory building over 10 m² typically needs a building permit, zoning setbacks apply, and the electrical connection needs an ESA permit. Rural properties may also be regulated by a conservation authority. We check before you order.

mainEntity.name: Is wood or electric better for a rural property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both work. Wood suits properties without a nearby electrical panel and owners who love the ritual of a fire; electric is simpler for everyday use. We can quote both.

mainEntity.name: How much does delivery and installation cost in King Township?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario, including King Township. Delivery only is $450. HST is shown separately on every quote.

mainEntity.name: What heater size does my sauna need?

acceptedAnswer.text: We size every heater to the sauna's interior volume plus extra for glass. None of our saunas take less than a 6 kW heater; larger models use 9 to 10.5 kW electric or a wood stove where there's room for its clearances.
